description: specs/04 section 3.4 and specs/08 section 4: the summon algorithm's test vectors. Generated by tools/gacha_model.py (the independent oracle, decision 46); HeroCat.Sim.Tests only reads it. Scripted vectors: start from 'setup' (pity, exp, totalPulls, copies), feed 'u' in order to Pull (mode pull) or Pull10 (mode pull10), compare each result and the banner state after. Rows: one Pull from pity and exp = threshold(level) - exp_per_pull. Monte Carlo: stream seed 7 from counter 0, banner exp held so each pull rolls at 'level'; then pulls/10 ten-pulls on a fresh stream of the same seed, each from pity 0 and exp = threshold(level); guaranteeFired counts ten-pulls whose slots 1-9 had no E+.
